Source: They focused on growing maize in parts of the country that were between 950 and 1700 metres above sea level, called mid-altitudes.

Yoruba: Wọ́n gbájú mọ́ gbígbin àgbàdo ní àwọn agbègbè orílẹ̀ èdè tó wà láàárín mítà 950 àti 1700 bí odò ṣe jìnà sílẹ̀, tí à ń pè ní àárín ìgasílẹ̀.
Zulu: Bagxile ekutshaleni ummbila ezingxenyeni zezwe ezaziphakathi kwamamitha angu-950 no-1700 ngaphezu kolwandle, okubizwa ngokuthi ama-mid-altitudes.
Hausa: Sun mayar da hankali ne kan noman masara a sassan ƙasar da ke tsakanin mita 950 zuwa 1700 a saman teku, wanda ake kira tsakiyar tudduna.
Northern Sotho: Ba beile šedi godimo ga go bjala lefela ka dikarolong tša naga tšeo di bego di le magareng ga dimetara tše 950 le 1700 go tloga kgatong ya lewatle, tše di bitšwago mabophagamo a magareng.
Amharic: ከ950 እስከ 1700 ሜትር ከባህር ጠለል በላይ ከፍታ ያላቸውን እና መካከለኛ ከፍታዎች በሚባሉ በሃገሪቱ የተወሰኑ ክፍሎች በቆሎን ማሳደግ ላይ አተኩረው ነበር፡፡

Source: In each plot, researchers monitored the maize in terms of how well the plants were growing, how much maize they produced, and their resistance to disease.
Luganda: Mu buli nnimiro, abanoonyereza baalondoola kasooli nga batunuulira obulungi bw’okukula kwa kasooli, obungi bw’akasooli eyavaako, ate n’okugumira endwadde.
Yoruba: Ní pílọ́ọ̀tì kọ̀ọ̀kan, àwọn olùṣèwádìí mójú tó àwọn àgbàdo náà ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú bí àwọn nǹkan oko náà ṣe ń dàgbà, iye àgbàdo tí wọ́n ń so, àti ìjàkadì wọn pẹ̀lú àwọn kòkòro apọ̀gbìn.
Zulu: Esiqeshini ngasinye, abacwaningi babegada ummbila ngokubheka ukuthi izitshalo zikhula kahle kangakanani, zikhiqiza umbila ongakanani, kanye nokumelana kwazo nezifo.
Hausa: A kowane fanni, masu bincike sun sanya ido a kan masarar ta fuskar yadda shukar ke girma, yawan masara da suke nomawa, da kuma jurewar cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Go serapa se sengwe le se sengwe, banyakišiši ba lekodišišitše ka moo mafela a bego a mela gabotse ka gona, ba be ba tšweletša mafela a makaakang, le go kgona go retelela malwetši.
Amharic: በእያንዳንዱ የእርሻ መሬት ተመራማሪዎቹ በቆሎውን ተክሎቹ ምን ያህል በደንብ እንዳደጉ፣ ምን ያህል በቆሎ እንዳመረቱ እና ለበሽታ ካላቸው ተጋትሮ አንጻር ተከታትለዋል፡፡

Source: They then analysed this data to determine which of the varieties were most “stable”, meaning that they were able to produce higher yields of maize consistently in different areas and under different environmental conditions.
Luganda: Olwo ate ne beekaliriza obubaka obwo okumanya ekika “ekyasinga okugumira embeera”, ekitegeeza nti ekisinga okuvaako amakungula amangi buli kiseera mu bitundu eby’enjawulo mu mbeera z’ekitundu ez’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n yànnàná dátà yìí láti mọ irúfẹ́ tó “dára” jù, èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé wọ́n lè pèse èrè oko àgbàdo tó pọ̀ lemọ́lemọ́ ní agbègbe ọ̀tọ̀tọ̀ àti lábẹ́ẹ ìyídà ọjọ́ oríṣiríṣi.
Zulu: Babe sebehlaziya le datha ukuze bathole ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo “ezimi kahle” kakhulu, okusho ukuthi zazikwazi ukukhiqiza isivuno esiphezulu sommbila ngokuqhubekayo ezindaweni ezahlukene nangaphansi kwezimo zemvelo ezihlukene.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi nazarin wannan bayanai don tantance wane iri ne suka fi “daidaito”, ma’ana suna iya samar da mafi yawan amfanin gona na masara akai-akai a wurare daban-daban da kuma yanayin muhalli daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga moo ba sekasekile datha ye go lemoga mehuta yeo e bego e “kgotlelela” kudu, go šupa gore ba be ba kgona go tšweletša dipuno tša godimodimo tša lefela ka mehla mafelong ao a fapafapanego le ka fase ga maemo ao a fapafapanego a tša tikologo.
Amharic: ከዛ ይህንን መረጃ የትኛዎቹ ዝርያዎች በጣም “የተረጋጉ” እንደሆኑ ለማወቅ ተንትነውታል፤ ይህም ማለት በመደበኛነት በተለያዩ ቦታዎች እና በተለያዩ አካባቢያዊ ሁኔታዎች ከፍተኛ የበቆሎ ምርትን መስጠት ችለዋለው ማለት ነው፡፡

Source: The researchers found large differences between the varieties, including how tall the plants grew, how much maize they produced, and how successfully they fought diseases.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula enjawulo nnene ddala mu bika by’akasooli, omwo nga mwe muli engeri ebirime gye byakulamu, obungi bw’akasooli eyavangako, n’engeri gye yasobola okulwanyisaamu endwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà rí ìyàtọ̀ ńlá láàárín oríṣi, tó níṣe pẹ̀lú bí ọ̀gbìn náà ti ga tó, iye àgbàdo tí wọ́n pèsè, àti bí wọ́n ṣe bá kòkòro apọ̀gbìn jìjàkadì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwezinhlobonhlobo, okuhlanganisa ukuthi izitshalo zikhule zinde kangakanani, zikhiqize umbila ongakanani, nokuthi zilwa ngempumelelo kangakanani nezifo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano bambance-bambance masu yawa a tsakanin nau'in, ciki har da tsayin tsire-tsire, yawan masara da suka yi, da kuma yadda suka yi nasarar yaƙi da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile diphapano tše kgolo magareng ga mehuta, go akaretša le botelele bjoo dimela di ka bo melago, ke kelo e kaakang ya lefela yeo e bego e tšweletšwa, le gore ba atlegile bjang go lwantšha malwetši ka katlego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በዝርያዎቹ መካከል ትልቅ ልዩነቶችን አግኝተዋል፣ እነዚህም አትክልቶቹ ምን ያህል ከፍ ብለው እንዳደጉ፣ ምን ያህል በቆሎ እንዳመረቱ እና በምን ያህል ስኬት በሽታዎችን እንደተዋጉ ያካትታሉ፡፡

Source: They also found that 12 of the varieties grew better in general in the three different areas, and consistently produced better than average maize yields.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti okutwaliza awamu, ebika 12 byakula mu ngeri esingako obulungi mu bitundu ebisatu eby’enjawulo, era nga byavaako amakungula ga kasooli agasinga obulungi ate nga tegakyusekyuse.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé 12 nínú àwọn oríṣi náà dàgbà dada lápapọ̀ ní àwọn agbègbè mẹ́ta náà, àti pé wón sèso ju àwọn ère oko àgbàdo tókù lọ.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlobo eziyi-12 zezinhlobo ezikhule kangcono ngokujwayelekile ezindaweni ezintathu ezihlukene, futhi bezilokhu zikhiqiza kangcono kunesilinganiso sokuvunwa kommbila.
Hausa: Har ila yau sun gano nau’o’i guda 12 sun fi girma gabaɗaya a cikin yankuna uku mabambanta, kuma suna samar da mafi kyawu akai-akai fiye da matsakaicin amfanin gona na masara.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše le gore mehuta ye 12 godimo ga palomoka ya mafela ao a bego a lengwa, e be e gola ka tshwanelo ka kakaretšo go ditikologo tše tharo tše di fapafapanego, le gore e tšweleditše dipuno tše kaone go feta dipuno tša lefela tša magareng.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ በሶስት የተለያዩ ቦታዎች 12 ያህሉ ዝርያዎች በጥቅሉ በተሻለ ሁኔታ እንዳደጉ እና ከአማካይ የበቆሎ ምርት ያለማቋረጥ የተሻለ እንዳመረቱ አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: They note that some of these varieties are new hybrid types produced by the Rwanda Agriculture Board, and that these are good candidates for growing in mid-altitudes in the country.
Luganda: Baakiraba nti ebimu ku bika ebyo bika bipya ebirongooseemu ebyakolebwa Ekitongole kya Rwanda eby’Ebyobulimi (Rwanda Agricultural Board), era nti ebyo bika birungi okulima mu bitundu ebigulumivumukko mu ggwanga eryo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé àwọn oríṣi yìí jẹ́ àpapọ̀ tuntun tí a ṣẹ̀dá láti Rwanda Agriculture Board, àti pé wọ́n jẹ́ ohun gidi fún ọ̀gbìn ní àárín ìgasílẹ̀ ní orílẹ̀ èdè náà.
Zulu: Baqaphela ukuthi ezinye zalezi zinhlobonhlobo ziyizinhlobo ezintsha ezihlanganisiwe ezikhiqizwe iRwanda Agriculture Board, nokuthi lezi zingamakhandidethi afanelekayo ekukhuleni ezindaweni eziphakeme ezimaphakathi nezwe.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa wasu nau’o’in waɗannan nau'o’in su ne sababbin garwayen nau'in da Hukumar Noma ta Ruwanda ta samar, kuma cewa waɗannan nau’o’i ne da za iya shukawa a tsakiyar tudunnan ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemoga gore ye mengwe ya mehuta ye ke mehuta ye meswa ya lepasetere ye e tšweletšwago ke Boto ya tša Temo ya Rwanda, le gore ye ke mehuta ye mekaone yeo e ka bjalwago go mabophagamo a magareng ka nageng.
Amharic: አንዳንዶቹ በሩዋንዳ የእርሻ ቦርድ የተመረቱ አዲስ የድቅል አይነቶች እንደሆኑ አሳስበዋል እናም እነዚህ በሃገሪቷ በመካከለኛ-ከፍታዎች ላይ ለማሳደግ ጥሩ እጩዎች ናቸው፡፡

Source: Researchers caution that they were only able to conduct their experiments for one growing season, and that one of their sites was subjected to a drought during this period, which would affect maize yields from that site.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza balabula nti okugezesa kwabwe baakukolera mu sizoni emu era nti ekimu ku bitundu mwe baakolera kyateekebwa mu mbeera ey’ekyeya mu kiseera ky’okugezesa, era nga kiyinza okukosa amakungula agava mu kitundu ekyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ṣèkìlọ̀ pé ọdún kan péré ni àwọn fi ṣe àyẹ̀wò náà, àti pé ọ̀kan nínú àwọn oko wọ́n wà ní ọ̀dá ní ìgbà náà, léyìí tó lẹ̀ ní ipa lórí erè oko àgbàdo láti oko náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi bakwazile kuphela ukwenza ucwaningo lwabo ngesikhathi esisodwa sokukhula, nokuthi enye yezindawo zabo yaba nesomiso ngalesi sikhathi, esizophazamisa isivuno sommbila kuleso siza.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa sun sami damar gudanar da gwaje-gwajen nasu ne kawai na noma guda ɗaya, kuma ɗaya daga cikin filayen nomansu ya fuskanci fari a wannan lokaci, wanda zai shafi noman masara daga wannan wurin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemoša gore ba kgonne go dira diteko tša bona go sehla se tee sa temo, le gore se tee sa ditsha tša bona se ile sa itemogela komelelo nakong ye, yeo e ka amago dipuno tša lefela go tšwa setsheng seo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሙከራቸውን በአንድ የመብቀያ ወቅት ብቻ እንዳካሄዱ ያሳስባሉ እናም አንዱ ጣቢያቸው በዚህ ወቅት ለድርቅ ተጋልጦ ነበር፣ ይህም በጣቢያው የበቆሎ ምርቶች ላይ ተጽእኖ ያደርጋል፡፡

Source: The study was a collaboration between scientists from Rwanda and Sweden.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakolebwa bannassaayansi okuva e Rwanda nga bali mu mukago ne bannassaayansi okuva e Buswedi.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà jẹ́ iṣẹ́ àjọṣe láàárín àwọn onímọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ sáyẹ́ǹsì láti orílẹ̀-èdè Rwanda àti Sweden.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lube ukukubambisana phakathi kososayensi base-Rwanda nase-Sweden.
Hausa: Binciken ya kasance na haɗin gwiwa tsakanin masana kimiyya daga Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Sweden.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo e bile tšhomišano magareng ga ditsebi tša mahlale go tšwa Rwanda le Sweden.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ከሩዋንዳ እና ከስዊድን በመጡ ሳይንቲስቶች ትብብር የተሰራ ነው።
